name: langchain
summary: LLM application framework for chains, agents, retrieval, and orchestration patterns.
why_it_matters: LangChain remains relevant ecosystem knowledge, but the old config-plus-registry entry was stale and did not represent an actively supported Vrooli integration.
when_to_use: A scenario genuinely benefits from LangChain-specific libraries or runtime semantics.
An implementation effort needs compatibility with existing LangChain assets or operator expectations.

platform_support.notes: The framework is cross-platform in principle, but support value depends on whether Vrooli wants to own a framework-level contract instead of narrower capabilities.

prerequisites: A scenario that truly needs LangChain rather than generic model/vector capabilities
A support model for Python environment management
implementation_notes: Treat this as a capability blueprint, not a signal to keep framework-specific stale config alive.
A future implementation should justify why framework coupling is worth it.
Prefer promoting narrower validated capabilities over broad framework wrappers.
operational_notes: Version churn in the LangChain ecosystem is a primary support risk.
Validation should cover real scenario behavior, not import-only checks.
risks: Framework wrappers can age quickly and duplicate functionality Vrooli already has.
Python dependency drift can raise maintenance cost fast.
